notes: New: a Plan / Auto switch on the run header. Until now every run started read-only — the agent could not change a single file until you approved the plan — and "Give edit access" only half-cleared it, so some of you hit a run that said it had access and still would not write. Auto is now the default: the agent can read, write and run commands from the start.

It is still your run. Auto changes what the agent is allowed to touch, not whether you get a say — the plan gate still stops and waits for you, and so does every other gate. Strict read-only is unaffected in both modes: the database stays read-only, enforced before the command runs.

The switch is per run and works mid-run. Click it halfway through and the fix restarts in the same session, so nothing already worked out is lost. Prefer the old behaviour? Pick Plan on the new-fix form, or set it as your default in Settings → Speed & model.
Fixed: a run resumed after closing the app came back with strict read-only silently switched off. It now keeps the protection it started with.
